pairs.claim: The empirical model of UK cat population dynamics was developed by the cited authors.
The temperature-dependent desert locust population model was introduced in the cited work.
The dynamic model of Borrelia burgdorferi prevalence was developed by the cited authors.
The synthesis of Salish Sea radiocarbon dates was produced by the cited authors.
Kernel Density Estimation was introduced by the cited authors.
Radiocarbon dating was first described in the cited work.
The concept of carrying capacity originates with this work.
Population viability analysis was invented by the cited authors.
The desert locust was first described by the cited authors.
The basic reproduction number was introduced in the cited work.
Borrelia burgdorferi was first identified by the cited authors.
The compartmental model of infectious disease originates with this work.
Lyme disease was first characterised by the cited authors.
The Bayesian calibration of radiocarbon dates was devised by the cited authors.
